loaderGeoModel.title: Basic Demo: Load Geometry
loaderGeoModel.desc: This demo shows how to load geometry model data. You can interact with the mouse:
loaderGeoModel.subdesc1: In finite element simulation, geometry defines the physical domain, boundary-condition locations, and mesh generation constraints.
loaderGeoModel.subdesc2: Before solving, geometry is usually prepared by defeaturing and cleanup, such as fillet/chamfer removal, gap repair, and watertight checks.
loaderGeoModel.subdesc3: After geometry preparation, a simulation-ready mesh can be generated with better robustness and quality.

loaderMeshModel.title: Basic Demo: Load Mesh
loaderMeshModel.desc: This demo shows how to load mesh model data. You can interact with the mouse:
loaderMeshModel.subdesc1: In finite element simulation, the mesh is the core discretization used for computation.
loaderMeshModel.subdesc2: The mesh converts a continuous physical problem into a numerically solvable mathematical system.
loaderMeshModel.subdesc3: Mesh quality controls convergence, numerical stability, and compute cost.

loaderSimulationResultModel.title: Basic Demo: Load Simulation Result
loaderSimulationResultModel.desc: This demo shows how to load simulation result data. You can interact with the mouse:
loaderSimulationResultModel.subdesc1: Use the left selector to choose the scalar type, and the right selector to choose its component.
loaderSimulationResultModel.subdesc2: A common review flow is: check equivalent stress hotspots first, inspect tensor components for load behavior, then verify displacement limits.
loaderSimulationResultModel.subdesc3: You can switch scalar fields and components interactively to compare different physical quantities.

loaderSimulationFramesResultModel.title: Basic Demo: Load Contour Model
loaderSimulationFramesResultModel.desc: This demo shows how to load contour model data. The default case is a simulation result model of a cube with a boss.
loaderSimulationFramesResultModel.subdesc1: This cube-plus-boss model is commonly used to simulate compressed structures and observe stress concentration at the boss root.
loaderSimulationFramesResultModel.subdesc2: Review a fixed base with a top load, and inspect Von Mises stress and deflection.
loaderSimulationFramesResultModel.subdesc3: This model is very common in finite element software for testing stress concentration, structural stiffness, mesh quality, and multi-quantity visualization.
